stations.title: Wilma
stations.say: Get the sale ready, live in July.
stations.note: The group's new time cannot wait.

stations.title: main
stations.text: One line of history, and it is the site.
stations.note: The sale would go out too early.

captions: Wilma wants the summer sale ready now, but not on the site before July.
With one line of history, the sale would go out early or hold everything up.
You make a branch for the sale and keep main for today's site, in four tasks.
The sale waits on its branch, and the reading group's new time goes out now.
Two lines of work, each moving at its own pace.
